title: RRB ALP CBT-II Admit Card 2026
vacancyDetails: 10970 Assistant Loco Pilot posts; CBT-2 admit card for ~1,58,705 CBT-1 qualified candidates
qualification: Matriculation / SSLC plus ITI / Act Apprenticeship or Diploma in Engineering as per CEN 01/2025
ageLimit: 18 to 30 years (as per ALP notification; relaxations as per rules)
selectionProcess: CBT-1 → CBT-2 → CBAT (as applicable) → Document Verification → Medical
documentsRequired: Registration number & password/DOB; printed admit card; original photo ID
howToApply:
1. Visit your regional RRB website or rrbcdg.gov.in
2. Open CEN 01/2025 ALP CBT-2 Admit Card link
3. Login with Registration Number and Password/DOB
4. Download and print e-Call Letter
5. Reach centre as per reporting time on hall ticket
shortDescription: RRB ALP CBT-2 Admit Card 2026 released on 24 July 2026 for exam on 28 July 2026 (CEN 01/2025). Download from regional RRB portals.
content:
Railway Recruitment Boards have released the ALP CBT-2 Admit Card 2026 for CEN 01/2025 on 24 July 2026.

CBT-2 is scheduled on 28 July 2026. City intimation was issued earlier (around 18–19 July 2026). About 1,58,705 CBT-1 qualified candidates can download hall tickets.

Key points

  • Vacancies: 10,970 ALP posts
  • Carry printed admit card + original photo ID
  • Check shift, centre address and COVID/exam instructions on the e-Call Letter
